scenario_title: ทริป Wat Arun Ratchawararam Ratchawaramahawihan 3 วัน

itinerary.date: Day 1 - Rattanakosin Island & Chao Phraya Historic Corridor

activities.title: Wat Arun Ratchawararam Ratchawaramahawihan
activities.title_th: วัดอรุณราชวรารามราชวรมหาวิหาร
activities.description: Cross the Chao Phraya river by ferry to visit the iconic Temple of Dawn with its towering central prang adorned with colorful porcelain mosaics.
activities.description_th: นั่งเรือข้ามฟากไปชมความสง่างามของพระปรางค์วัดอรุณฯ ประดับกระเบื้องเคลือบลวดลายละเอียดงดงามริมฝั่งธนบุรี
activities.description_en: Take a short cross-river ferry to admire the towering Khmer-style prang of Wat Arun decorated with colorful glazed ceramics.

activities.title: Wat Phra Kaew
activities.title_th: วัดพระศรีรัตนศาสดาราม (วัดพระแก้ว)
activities.title_en: Wat Phra Kaew (Temple of the Emerald Buddha)
activities.description: Start the day exploring the sacred Temple of the Emerald Buddha within the Grand Palace complex, admiring the intricate Thai architecture and the venerated green jasper Buddha image.
activities.description_th: เริ่มต้นเช้าวันแรกด้วยการสักการะพระแก้วมรกตและชมความวิจิตรงดงามของสถาปัตยกรรมไทยโบราณในพระบรมมหาราชวัง
activities.description_en: Begin the morning visiting the sacred Emerald Buddha and marveling at the ornate Thai craftsmanship across the Grand Palace grounds.

activities.title: Tha Tien Street Food & Riverside Dining
activities.title_th: ร้านอาหารและสตรีตฟู้ดย่านท่าเตียน
activities.description: Enjoy a delicious authentic lunch featuring Pad Thai, Tom Yum, and fresh coconut water at the vibrant eateries of historic Tha Tien pier.
activities.description_th: แวะรับประทานอาหารกลางวันรสเลิศย่านท่าเตียน ทั้งผัดไทย ต้มยำกุ้ง และอาหารตามสั่งริมแม่น้ำเจ้าพระยา
activities.description_en: Savor authentic Thai lunch dishes like Pad Thai and Tom Yum at the vibrant heritage eateries of Tha Tien pier.

activities.title: Sanam Luang & Rattanakosin Island Walk
activities.title_th: สนามหลวง และเกาะรัตนโกสินทร์
activities.title_en: Sanam Luang & Rattanakosin Island Heritage Walk
activities.description: Cross back and stroll through the open historic grounds of Sanam Luang and surrounding colonial-era heritage government buildings.
activities.description_th: เดินเล่นรับลมช่วงบ่ายแก่ๆ ชมทัศนียภาพรอบสนามหลวงและอาคารสถาปัตยกรรมเก่าแก่บนเกาะรัตนโกสินทร์
activities.description_en: Stroll across the historic royal field of Sanam Luang surrounded by grand heritage architecture of old Bangkok.

activities.title: Central Eastville Outdoor Lifestyle Mall
activities.title_th: เซ็นทรัล อีสต์วิลล์
activities.description: Spend a relaxed afternoon in this open-air lifestyle mall featuring breezy green walkways, boutique shops, art installations, and air-conditioned entertainment.
activities.description_th: เดินช้อปปิ้งและถ่ายรูปในคอมมูนิตี้มอลล์กึ่งกลางแจ้งที่ร่มรื่นด้วยต้นไม้ มีร้านค้าแฟชั่นและคาเฟ่เก๋ๆ มากมาย
activities.description_en: Explore an eco-friendly open-air mall filled with green rest areas, international brands, and stylish boutiques.

activities.title: Khaosan Road Nightlife & Street Dining
activities.title_th: ถนนข้าวสาร
activities.description: Conclude the day at Bangkok's renowned entertainment walking street with vibrant open-air bars, lively music, and endless street food treats.
activities.description_th: สัมผัสบรรยากาศความสนุกสนานยามค่ำคืน ลิ้มลองอาหารริมทางและดื่มด่ำกับเสียงดนตรีบนถนนข้าวสาร
activities.description_en: Experience the famous lively evening ambiance with street stalls, bars, music, and socializing with fellow travelers.

itinerary.date: Day 2 - Dusit & Bang Sue Historical District

activities.title: Chatuchak Park
activities.title_th: สวนจตุจักร
activities.description: Relax along shaded walking trails, rent a swan paddleboat on the serene lake, and enjoy late afternoon golden hour breezes.
activities.description_th: พักผ่อนหย่อนใจใต้ร่มเงาต้นไม้ ปั่นเรือเป็ดในทะเลสาบ และรับลมเย็นยามเย็นในสวนสาธารณะขนาดใหญ่
activities.description_en: Take a tranquil green walk and paddle around the lake in one of north Bangkok's most pleasant public parks.

activities.title: Lunch near Field Marshal Plaek Phibunsongkhram Monument
activities.description: Authentic local midday lunch and dining near Field Marshal Plaek Phibunsongkhram Monument.

activities.title: Field Marshal Plaek Phibunsongkhram Monument
activities.title_th: อนุสาวรีย์จอมพล ป. พิบูลสงคราม
activities.description: Visit the historical monument honoring one of modern Thailand's most influential prime ministers and military leaders, learning about mid-20th-century Thai history.
activities.description_th: เยี่ยมชมอนุสาวรีย์รำลึกถึงจอมพล ป. พิบูลสงคราม บุคคลสำคัญในประวัติศาสตร์การเมืองและการพัฒนาชาติไทยสมัยใหม่
activities.description_en: Discover the legacy of modern Thai political history at this monument dedicated to Field Marshal Plaek Phibunsongkhram.

activities.title: Pracha Chuen Night Street Food Market
activities.title_th: ตลาดอาหารกลางคืนถนนประชาชื่น
activities.description: Feast on grilled seafood, spicy salads, satay, and sweet mango sticky rice at the bustling community night food market alongside canal Pracha Chuen.
activities.description_th: เพลิดเพลินกับมื้อค่ำแสนอร่อย ทั้งซีฟู้ดย่าง ยำรสแซ่บ หมูสะเต๊ะ และข้าวเหนียวมะม่วงริมคลองประชาชื่น
activities.description_en: Dine on grilled skewers, spicy seafood salads, and Thai sweets at this vibrant local evening street food strip.

itinerary.date: Day 3 - Wang Thonglang Green Spaces & Lifestyle

activities.title: Wang Thong Public Park 1
activities.title_th: สวนสาธารณะวังทอง 1
activities.description: Start a refreshing morning with a peaceful stroll or light jog along the tree-lined paths and landscaped gardens of Wang Thong 1 Park.
activities.description_th: เริ่มต้นเช้าที่สดชื่นด้วยการเดินเล่นและออกกำลังกายเบาๆ ท่ามกลางแมกไม้นานาพันธุ์ในสวนสาธารณะวังทอง 1
activities.description_en: Breathe fresh air on a morning nature walk through the lush green tracks of Wang Thong 1 Park.

activities.title: Wang Thong Public Park 2
activities.title_th: สวนสาธารณะวังทอง 2
activities.description: Explore the connected companion park featuring open pavilions, ornamental plants, and community relaxation corners ideal for friends chatting and photos.
activities.description_th: เดินข้ามมาพักผ่อนต่อที่สวนสาธารณะวังทอง 2 ถ่ายรูปกับสวนหย่อมและศาลาพักผ่อนริมน้ำ

activities.title: Wat Arun Ratchawararam Ratchawaramahawihan
activities.description: Marvel at the majestic porcelain-encrusted central prang rising gracefully on the west bank of the Chao Phraya River.

activities.title: Chaloem La Park
activities.description: Explore an urban community art pocket park renowned for dynamic street art, colorful graffiti murals, and youth culture.

activities.title: Siam Square Walking Street
activities.description: Stroll down Bangkok's vibrant epicenter of youth fashion, flagship concept boutiques, open-air entertainment, and cafes.

activities.title: Ruam Mit Phochana Bang Pho
activities.description: Dine on heritage roasted duck, braised pork noodles, and savory Cantonese-style gravy dishes popular with local residents.

activities.title: Krua Apsorn Dinso Road
activities.description: Savor authentic royal-recipe Thai home cooking, world-famous for its fluffy crab omelet and yellow curry with lotus stems.

activities.description: Observe this historic military monument dedicated to the former Prime Minister who shaped modern 20th-century Thailand.

activities.title: Ban Thad Thong Street Food
activities.description: Taste your way through Bangkok's trendiest evening culinary strip featuring crispy pork, claypot noodles, and shaved ice desserts.

activities.title: Sappaya-Sapasathan Riverfront Promenade
activities.description: Admire Thailand's grand national parliament building, an architectural landmark blending modern scale with traditional Buddhist cosmology.

activities.title: Soi Pracha Narumit Woodworking Street
activities.description: Walk through Bangkok's historic carpentry street featuring master woodworkers, hand-carved furniture, and scented timber crafts.

activities.title: Tao Poon Evening Market
activities.description: Feast on authentic local evening street food ranging from boat noodles to crispy roti and fresh tropical fruit shakes.

itinerary.date: Day 1 - 21 September 2026: Historic Rattanakosin & Riverside Heritage

activities.title: Saranrom Royal Garden
activities.description: Stroll south through a tranquil heritage park that once served as the royal garden for Saranrom Palace.

activities.title: Tha Tien Street Food & Riverside Eateries
activities.description: Enjoy authentic Thai dishes like Pad Thai, Tom Yum, and fried river fish right next to the river pier.

activities.title: Wat Phra Kaew & Grand Palace
activities.description: Marvel at Thailand's most revered temple housing the Emerald Buddha and walk through the stunning Grand Palace complex.
activities.english_name: Temple of the Emerald Buddha and Grand Palace

activities.title: Hua Mum Night Market
activities.description: Conclude the trip with a vibrant night market packed with seafood feasts, quirky crafts, live music, and energetic vibes.

activities.title: Field Marshal Plaek Phibunsongkhram Monument
activities.description: Discover Modern Thai history and political heritage at this historical military academy monument.

activities.title: Wat Arun Ratchawararam Ratchawaramahawihan
activities.description: Take a short cross-river ferry to admire the towering porcelain-encrusted central prang rising gracefully by the Chao Phraya River.

activities.title: Tha Maharaj Riverside Walk & Dining
activities.description: Take the scenic river ferry north and unwind with dinner and evening drinks overlooking illuminated boats on the Chao Phraya River.

itinerary.date: Day 2 - 22 September 2026: Dusit & Bang Sue Historic Corridor

activities.title: Bangsue Local Street Food Hub
activities.description: Savor authentic Thai dishes, boat noodles, Hainanese chicken rice, and traditional desserts loved by local residents.
activities.english_name: Tao Poon Bang Sue Food Hub

activities.title: Wat Soi Thong
activities.description: Visit a prominent riverside Buddhist temple known for its golden hall, sacred Luang Phor Luea Buddha image, and serene water view.

activities.title: Bang Pho Riverside Promenade & Night Eateries
activities.description: Experience sunset dining by the river and taste legendary Bang Pho Chinese noodles and charcoal-grilled treats.

itinerary.date: Day 3 - 23 September 2026: Wang Thonglang Green & Lifestyle Hub

activities.title: Wang Thong Public Park 1
activities.description: Start your morning with a refreshing nature jog and scenic tree-lined stroll around the community lake.

activities.title: Wang Thong Public Park 2
activities.description: Recharge under leafy canopies and take photographs along picturesque shaded wooden footbridges.

activities.title: Town in Town Artisan Food & Bistro
activities.description: Enjoy a relaxed lunch offering authentic northern Thai khao soi, pasta, and specialty drip coffees in the creative quarter.

typicalWeather.description: Tropical monsoon season with warm temperatures, high humidity, and frequent afternoon or evening rain showers.
typicalWeather.tips: Carry a compact umbrella or rain poncho, wear breathable fabrics, and dress respectfully (shoulders and knees covered) for temple visits.
